I work on **generative retrieval** — training LLMs to index documents by generating semantic IDs — and on detecting when those pipelines make things up.

Previously Huawei Amsterdam (multimodal retrieval for Petal Search) and Qwant (image search at 400 QPS over 15B documents). PhD from CNAM Paris.

## Selected work

- [**artefactual**](software.qmd) — scores how likely an LLM answer is to be a hallucination, from logprobs alone. ECIR 2026.
- [**LEDGER**](publications.qmd) — long-context benchmark of 4,999 annual reports for grounded financial retrieval. CIKM 2026, Resource Track.
